description: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope of fulfillment-execution's TaskCompleted v1 as consumed here (not composed from CloudEventBase, whose `source` is this service's own). Only the fields this service reads are listed under `data`; the producer sends more.

id.description: CloudEvents id; the dedupe key (claimed in processed_events under consumer `task-completed-confirm-pick`, or `task-completed-relocate` for RELOCATE tasks).

subject.description: The task id (also the Kafka key).

task_type.description: PICK and RELOCATE are acted on; omitted by the producer when the task could not be found.

order_ref.description: The completed task's order reference = the OrderId order-management reserved against (this service's reservation `demand_ref`). Every PICK task of an order (one per order line) carries the same value. Additive and optional (ADR 0035): omitted when empty, in which case nothing is counted or confirmed.

line_no.description: The order line this task was for (the `line_no` the reservation of that line was made with). Additive and optional (ADR 0036): omitted when unknown. When present, exactly the ACTIVE reservation(s) of (`order_ref`, `line_no`) are confirmed and nothing is counted; when absent the ADR 0035 last-pick counting applies. A value outside 1..2147483647 (the 32-bit line_no column) or a non-integer is a malformed payload (dead-lettered).

sku.description: RELOCATE only (additive, ADR 0039): the SKU moved. Required on a RELOCATE completion (missing or invalid = dead-lettered); absent on every other task type.

from_bin.description: RELOCATE only (additive, ADR 0039): the source bin's location code; its site is the move's site.

to_bin.description: RELOCATE only (additive, ADR 0039): the destination bin's location code; must be a different bin of the same site.

quantity.description: RELOCATE only (additive, ADR 0039): the units moved. Missing, zero or negative on a RELOCATE completion = dead-lettered.

relocation_ref.description: RELOCATE only (additive, ADR 0039, optional): the slot-plan move the task executes; stored as the relocation's source_ref (the task id is used when absent).
